description:
Directory of ERC-8004 agents that answered a well-formed HTTP 402 x402 challenge during our last field probe. OBSERVATION ONLY — not a score, ranking, or endorsement.

Args (ALL OPTIONAL — call with `{}` for the top 10 across both chains):
    chain: one of "base", "ethereum" (omit for both). Default: null.
    limit: 1..10 rows (free-tier cap). Default: 10.
Returns per-row raw probe facts: agent_id, chain, endpoint_url, http_402_ok, network, asset, price_usd as the challenge advertised, payTo_present (boolean — the actual address is paid), sibling_agent_ids (other ERC-8004 ids served by the same gateway row — the 'shared operator' cue), probed_at. Plus `total_endpoints_valid_402` and `total_agents_valid_402` so a caller can see what fraction of the surface this free slice covers.

Source: the 0946 field-test one-shot probe (unauthenticated, read-only, no payment signed). See the `field_test_url` field for the full writeup.

Paid counterpart: the paid x402 /v1/intel/* endpoints return the same-origin enriched intel on any single agent in this list — owner identity, payment history, peers, trust verdict, Sybil-adjusted reputation. Every response from this free tool carries an `unlock` + `paid_upgrade` block with the exact paid endpoint, price, and payment discovery.
name: list_payable_x402_endpoints
